    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    fits = bins >= item
    rem = bins - item
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    is_empty = (bins == max_cap) | (bins == np.max(bins)) if len(bins) > 0 else np.array([])
    
    if np.any(fits):
        # Among fitting bins, prefer tightest fit (min remaining capacity), but penalize empty bins to avoid opening new ones prematurely
        tightness = 1.0 - (rem[fits] / max_cap)
        # If a bin is at max capacity (effectively empty), give it a lower base score
        bin_penalties = np.where(bins[fits] == max_cap, 0.5, 0.0)
        scores[fits] = tightness - bin_penalties
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    fits = bins >= item
    slack = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if np.any(fits):
        valid_slack = slack[fits]
        min_slack = np.min(valid_slack)
        max_slack = np.max(valid_slack) if np.max(valid_slack) > np.min(valid_slack) else 1.0
        scores[fits] = 1.0 - (valid_slack - min_slack) / (max_slack - min_slack + 1e-9)
    empty_mask = (bins == np.max(bins)) & (~fits | (slack == np.max(slack[fits]) if np.any(fits) else True))
    if not np.any(fits) and len(bins) > 0:
        scores = -bins.astype(float)
    return scores
